comment: The Activa was spotless and delivered right on time at Kothrud. Suresh ji is extremely polite and provided a fresh sanitized helmet.
Rented the Classic 350 for a trip to Lavasa. Thump and pickup were fantastic, great brakes and comfort seat.
Ather 450X made my Baner-Hinjewadi commute effortless. Saved all petrol money and touchscreen maps worked smoothly.
Splendor gave over 65 km/l across Pune! Ganesh ji gave full fuel tank and security money returned in 10 minutes.
Great Pulsar 150 with dual disc brakes. Super grip on highway. Very responsive owner.
Jupiter 125 boot space is amazing! Could easily keep 2 helmets and shopping bags. Delivered to doorstep.
Duke 200 rocket acceleration! In showroom condition with brand new tyres. Pure adrenaline!
TVS iQube is whisper-quiet. Q-park reverse feature made parking in Pimple Saudagar markets a breeze.
First time riding an electric bike (Tork Kratos R). Made in Pune and performs like a beast!
Yamaha FZ radial tyre gives great stability on wet tarmac. Owner delivered right to Hadapsar Gadital.
Access 125 suspension is very smooth for Pune potholes. Excellent service.
Ola S1 Pro party speakers are fun! Fast pickup and good range across Hinjewadi Phase 1 & 2.
Hunter 350 is super easy to handle compared to heavier Bullets. Great for city riding.
Apache RTR 160 4V engine sound is pure bliss. Very smooth gear shifts.
Bajaj Chetak solid steel body feels very safe. Battery lasted more than 110 km comfortably.
Revolt RV400 futuristic feel! People turned heads at traffic signals.
Honda Shine gives smooth ride and zero fatigue during long traffic delays.
RayZR is so lightweight! Easy to mount on double stand and quick acceleration.
Pleasure Plus seat height was perfect for me. The backrest is very comfortable for the pillion.
Avenger 220 highway posture is royal. Great low seat and windshield blocked evening wind.
